profile.headline: Software Engineer III at SMC3
profile.summary:
A software developer and esports competitor infinitely searching for new ways to challenge myself, hurt my brain, become more teachable, and, most importantly, grow.

github.com/riddleew

positions.title: The Software Guild Apprentice
positions.description:
•	An intense 12-week program that produces full stack junior Java developers.
•	Helped various students with code reviews and subject matter.
•	Designed several projects showcasing mastery in the current curriculum (notable projects found here https://github.com/riddleew)
•	Technologies used: Java, My SQL, HTML/CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery, Ajax, JSON, REST API, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, MVC Architecture, JDBC Template, JUnit Testing, Test Driven Development,  OOP Concepts, Agile Development, Version Control (Git)

positions.title: Consumer Insights Analyst; Temporary
positions.description:
•	Performed quantitative and qualitative analyses to identify key trends, issues, and opportunities that would promote growth for our brands
•	Introduced my team to a client that has been both resourceful and long-time partners with them
•	Created and presented decks to our brands to share insights that would help them move forward with making critical decisions for their product(s)
•	Exported, organized and aggregated data per request

positions.title: Broadcaster
positions.description:
•	Pursued an entrepreneurial role by partnering with Twitch to produce online content that educated, entertained and maintained interest in my audience which ranged upwards to hundreds of viewers
•	Recruited and managed moderators that would regulate rules for viewers to follow
•	Studied stream viewership analytics and created plans that would help promote the brand
•	Marketed myself in various locations via the web and in-person in order to grow my community

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
IT Consultant
•	Worked as a team to provide VMware solutions to clients while creating and maintaining virtual environments
•	Customer facing while expressing competency in the technology of their interest
•	Underwent numerous trainings and webinars related to technologies such as VMware, Brocade, Hitachi, etc. along with pursuing multiple certifications (listed below)

Data Center Maintenance
•	Relocated to work  in a Data Center in which response time and availability was held to high importance in order to maintain a healthy working environment for our offshore team to use
•	Created thorough rack information sheets detailing every server and application utilized by the DC
•	Installed/uninstalled network cables and servers
•	Managed shipment of servers along with racking and unracking them as needed
•	Participated in multiple maintenance windows while providing touch-based services as needed

Achievements/Certifications
•	Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundations       		November 21, 2014
•	VMware Certified Associate – Data Center Virtualization 			                November 15, 2014
•	VMware Certified Professional – Data Center Virtualization		                        March 15, 2015

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
•	Led a team of undergraduate interns by managing meetings and communicating with supervisors
•	Collaborated with various companies to enhance broadband within Kentucky
•	Contributed to creating a Software Requirement Specifications document for the client
•	Worked on Developing a website via the CMS Squarespace
•	Helped develop a web application in the ASP.NET framework

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description:
•	Engaged students with mathematics to help them learn the material in a proficient manner
•	Communicated and worked together with a large number of students on a daily basis
•	Professionally presented authority amongst the math lab in a way that helped maintain the integrity of the work environment (prohibiting talking, cheating, etc.)

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
•	Responsible for updating a heavily populated database of clients in order to bring relevant information to their sales team
•	Worked on designing a project that helped distribute clients to the sales team in an efficient manner
